LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS oxygen_count
  FROM atom a
  JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id
) AS oxygen_counts;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS average_single_bonded_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id)) AS percent_carbon
FROM 
  atom a
  JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
  b.bond_type = '=';
```

```sql
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
```
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT a1.atom_id) AS iodine_atoms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a2.atom_id) AS sulfur_atoms
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id AND a1.element = 'i'
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id AND a2.element = 's'
WHERE 
    b.bond_type = '-';
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t2.element = 'f' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t1.molecule_id)) AS percentage
FROM 
  molecule t1
JOIN 
  atom t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id
WHERE 
  t1.label = '+';
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
  b.bond_type, 
  COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
  m.label
FROM 
  bond b
JOIN 
  molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
  b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY 
  b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY 
  bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;
```

LLM Response: SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n') OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p')
成功生成SQL: SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n') OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p')

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT AVG(bond_count) AS average_bonds
FROM (
  SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM atom a
  LEFT JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE a.element = 'i'
  GROUP BY a.atom_id
) AS iodine_atoms;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id)), 
    5
  ) AS proportion_carcinogenic_single_bonds
FROM 
  bond b
JOIN 
  molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
  b.bond_type = '-';
```

FROM

JOIN 
```sql
  bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
```

```sql
SELECT MAX(t2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / t2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores t1

WHERE (t1.NumGE1500 / t1.NumTstTakr) > 0.3;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.CharterNum, 
    AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) AS AverageWritingScore
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    ss.AvgScrWrite > 499
GROUP BY 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.CharterNum
ORDER BY 
    AverageWritingScore DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT s.School, f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, st.NumGE1500
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
    s.School, 
    CONCAT(s.Street, ', ', s.City, ', ', s.State, ' ', s.Zip) AS Full_Communication_Address
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Monterey' 
    AND s.School LIKE '%High School%'
    AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
WITH avg_diff AS (
  SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS avg_difference
  FROM frpm
  JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
  WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Local'
),
school_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS difference
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.FundingType = 'Local'
)
SELECT 
  sd.School,
  sd.DOCType
FROM school_diff sd
JOIN avg_diff ad ON sd.difference > ad.avg_difference;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
```
```sql
    s.School, 
    (f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS Eligible_FRPM_Rate
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.NCESDist = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS AverageTestTakers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'
  AND sc.County = 'Fresno';
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT s.School, s.County
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.AvgScrRead) 
    FROM satscores t
    JOIN schools sc ON t.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sc.County = s.County AND t.AvgScrRead > ss.AvgScrRead
) < 5
ORDER BY s.County, ss.AvgScrRead DESC;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT s.School, CONCAT(s.Street, ', ', s.City, ', ', s.State, ' ', s.Zip) AS PostalAddress
FROM satscores ss
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND s.Charter = 0
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
    s.School,
    (f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100) AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Los Angeles' 
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%K-9%';
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
    s.City, 
    COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS num_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_multiple_provision_types
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.GSserved LIKE '%K-8%' 
    AND s.Magnet = 1
GROUP BY 
    s.City;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
```
```sql
    t1.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F') AS salary_gap
FROM 
    client t1
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        account_id, 
        MIN(birthdate) AS oldest_birthdate,
        MIN(A11) AS lowest_avg_salary
     FROM 
        client
     WHERE 
        gender = 'F'
     GROUP BY 
        account_id) t2
ON 
    t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.birthdate = t2.oldest_birthdate AND t1.A11 = t2.lowest_avg_salary;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT account_id, MIN(amount) AS min_approved_amount
FROM loan
WHERE status = 'A' AND YEAR(date) = 1997
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING min_approved_amount = (
    SELECT MIN(amount)
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'A' AND YEAR(date) = 1997
)
AND account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE frequency = 'WEEKLY'
);
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT a.account_id, MAX(l.amount) AS max_approved_amount
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12 AND YEAR(a.date) = 1993 AND l.status = 'approved'
GROUP BY a.account_id
HAVING max_approved_amount = (
    SELECT MAX(l.amount)
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 12 AND YEAR(a.date) = 1993 AND l.status = 'approved'
);
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) 
FROM client c
JOIN account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN gender g ON c.gender = g.gender
WHERE c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' 
AND c.gender = 'F'
AND a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Sokolov');
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(c.client_id)) * 100 AS percentage_male_clients
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    d.A3 = 'south Bohemia' AND d.A4 = (SELECT MAX(A4) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia');
```

LLM Response: ```sql
WITH FirstLoan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
BalanceDates AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM FirstLoan) AND date = '1998-12-27') AS balance_1998,
        (SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM FirstLoan) AND date = '1993-03-22') AS balance_1993
)
SELECT 
    ((balance_1998 - balance_1993) / balance_1993) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM BalanceDates;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount)) * 100 AS percentage_running_no_issue
FROM 
  loan
WHERE 
  amount < 100000;
```

```sql
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id

ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT d.A2 AS District_Name, SUM(t.amount) AS Total_Withdrawal
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01-%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY Total_Withdrawal DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT t1.account_id
FROM trans t1
JOIN card c ON t1.account_id = c.disp_id
WHERE t1.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND t1.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t1.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) 
                   FROM trans 
                   WHERE date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
                     AND operation = 'VYBER KARTOU');
```

```sql
SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, a.date, c.district_id
FROM account a
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
```

The above query is not completely accurate as per the question. The correct query should list the distinct `frequency` (account type) that are not eligible for loans and the average income of residents in the district where the account is located exceeds $8000 but is no more than $9000. 

Here's the corrected SQL:

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT a.frequency AS account_type
FROM account a
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN income i ON c.client_id = i.link_to_member
WHERE a.frequency != 'OWNER' 
GROUP BY a.frequency, c.district_id
HAVING AVG(i.amount) > 8000 AND AVG(i.amount) <= 9000;
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT 
```
```sql
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.date) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) /
     SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'M' AND (YEAR(l.date) = 1996 OR YEAR(l.date) = 1997);
```

LLM Response: ```sql
SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A2 = 'east Bohemia' AND YEAR(a.date) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;
```
